Welcome. This blog is where I'll write about applied econometrics, forecasting, data science workflows, and whatever I find worth sharing from my work at Kapitalo.

Topics I expect to cover:

- Inflation nowcasting and forecasting models
- Bayesian methods in macroeconomics
- R and Python for economic research
- Reproducible research with Quarto

Posts are published when they're ready, not on a schedule. Stay tuned.
